## Hinge question {#fm3-hinge .fm-slide }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge fm-hinge"><p class="hinge-question">$1000 earns 10% p.a. compound interest, compounded annually. How much interest is earned <strong>during the second year alone</strong>?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>$100</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>$110</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>$210</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>$1210</span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>2. The second year starts with $1100, so its interest is 10% of $1100 = $110.</div></div>
```

::: notes
Additional diagnostic question. Default 60 seconds. Students begin with a fist on their chest, think independently, and show 1–4 fingers simultaneously on your verbal “show” cue. Collect responses before revealing. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer.

Correct answer: 2.
1: uses the original principal, as in simple interest.
3: gives the accumulated interest over both years.
4: gives the final balance after two years.

Ready: ask why year 3 would earn more again, then proceed to Example 3.2.
Divided: ask pairs to label the opening balance, new interest and closing balance for year 2. Re-poll.
Further explanation needed: write 1000 + 100 = 1100 for year 1; circle 1100 as the year-2 base and calculate its 10%. Re-poll.
:::
